title: Nazi aneutronic fusion bomb traded away for amnesty

tellings.quote: >> If the Nazis developed that in 1944 to 45, >> Mhm. >> atom bombs would be like matches for them.

plain: In 1944 and 1945, this story goes, Nazi Germany may have developed a bomb based on aneutronic fusion, a kind of nuclear fusion that gives off very little neutron radiation, and the weapon was later traded away in exchange for amnesty. The researcher Jason Jorjani lays this out for Michels without naming a source, and says that if the Nazis really had it, "atom bombs would be like matches for them."
